Return a tibble containing a summary of the results from a fishblicc fit

Source: R/BLICC_Tables.R
blicc_results.Rd

This function provides a summary of results from the fitted model in a form suitable for displaying in a table. Note that other packages, such as rstan, bayesplot and posterior can extract information from the stanfit object and the blicc_ref_pts rp_df 'draws' object in more detailed form.

Usage

blicc_results(blicc_res)

Arguments

blicc_res

Results from blicc_fit (stanfit object), blicc_mpd or blicc_ref_pts

Value

A tibble summarising results of the model fit object.

Examples

blicc_results(trgl_slim)
#> # A tibble: 13 × 5
#>    Parameter       Mean        SD `N (eff)`  Rhat
#>    <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl> <dbl>
